description: Loop-core multi-agent coding tool that orchestrates work through plan→implement→review cycles. The    orchestrator is read-only — it searches project memory, enforces custom rules, and delegates all code    changes to parallel swarm sub-agents. Built on Kimi Code CLI (MIT).
